doc: Synthetic interview mails (fictional people and companies, no real data) with the schedule each must give. Expected instants are computed independently from IANA zone rules, not by the code under test.

cases.desc: Weekday, month day, 12h with PT, a duration and a Zoom link
cases.subject: Interview invitation: Data Engineer at Proseware
cases.body:
Hi Priya, we'd like to invite you to an interview for the Data Engineer role. It is scheduled for Tuesday, October 27 at 2:00 PM PT and will last about 45 minutes. We will meet over Zoom: https://proseware.zoom.us/j/111222333

Thanks,
Recruiting

cases.desc: mm/dd/yyyy with 2pm and no zone: the zone of the Date header
cases.subject: Interview with Alpine Ski House
cases.body: Your interview with Alpine Ski House is on 10/27/2026 2pm. Looking forward to speaking with you.

cases.desc: A range "between 2:00 and 3:00 PM Eastern" after the date
cases.subject: Interview with Coho Winery
cases.body: Your interview with Coho Winery is confirmed for Wednesday, November 4, between 2:00 and 3:00 PM Eastern.

cases.desc: 24-hour clock with UTC+1 and an ordinal day
cases.subject: Video interview with Woodgrove Bank
cases.body: Please join the video interview with Woodgrove Bank on Wednesday Oct 21st, 14:00 UTC+1 (confirmed).

cases.desc: Day-month-year order; CET on a date that is in summer time is read as Central European time
cases.subject: Interview with Trey Research
cases.body: Your interview with Trey Research is on 5 October 2026 at 15:30 CET.

cases.desc: IST is India Standard Time
cases.subject: Interview with Margie's Travel
cases.body: Your interview with Margie's Travel is confirmed for Thursday, November 12 at 4:00 PM IST.

cases.desc: The day clocks go forward: a time after the change keeps the new offset
cases.subject: Interview with Fourth Coffee
cases.body: Your interview with Fourth Coffee is confirmed for Sunday, March 8, 2026 at 9:00 AM PDT.

cases.desc: A local time that does not exist (2:30 AM on the spring-forward day) moves forward and is not trusted
cases.subject: Interview with Contoso Pharma
cases.body: Interview with Contoso Pharma: Sunday, March 8 at 2:30 AM PT.

cases.desc: The hour that happens twice: PST names the second one
cases.subject: Interview with Adventure Works
cases.body: Interview with Adventure Works: Sunday, November 1, 2026 at 1:30 AM PST.

cases.desc: The hour that happens twice: PDT names the first one
cases.subject: Interview with Adventure Works
cases.body: Interview with Adventure Works: Sunday, November 1, 2026 at 1:30 AM PDT.

cases.desc: The day after clocks go back
cases.subject: Interview with Lucerne Publishing
cases.body: Your interview with Lucerne Publishing is confirmed: Monday, November 2 at 9:00 AM PST.

cases.desc: 12:00 PM is noon
cases.subject: Interview with Blue Yonder Airlines
cases.body: Your interview with Blue Yonder Airlines is confirmed for Friday, October 30 at 12:00 PM EDT.

cases.desc: 24-hour afternoon time and the +05:30 zone of the Date header
cases.subject: Interview with Contoso India
cases.body: Interview with Contoso India on 12 November 2026 at 16:00.

cases.desc: January in a December mail is next year
cases.subject: Interview with Northwind Traders
cases.body: Interview with Northwind Traders: Tuesday, January 5 at 10:00 AM ET.

cases.desc: The new time is the one after "rescheduled to"; the original is skipped
cases.subject: Rescheduled: interview with Northwind Traders
cases.body: Your interview, originally scheduled for Friday, October 30 at 12:00 PM PT, has been rescheduled to Friday, November 6 at 10:30 AM PT. We apologise for the change.

cases.desc: A reschedule with no new time gives no schedule (never the old one)
cases.subject: Interview with Tailwind Traders needs to move
cases.body: Your interview with Tailwind Traders needs to be rescheduled. We will send a new invitation shortly. It was set for Friday, October 30 at 12:00 PM PT.

cases.desc: A cancellation names the interview by its time; the status is not touched
cases.subject: Interview with Relecloud cancelled
cases.body: Unfortunately we need to cancel our interview with Relecloud scheduled for Tuesday, November 3 at 9:00 AM PT. We will be in touch to rebook.

cases.desc: An availability request that names a week and hours is not a schedule
cases.subject: Interview with Northwind
cases.body: We'd love to schedule an interview with you. Please share your availability for the week of October 26: any time between 9 AM and 5 PM PT works.

cases.desc: Two possible times are options, not a schedule
cases.subject: Interview with Humongous Insurance
cases.body: Are you free Tuesday, October 27 at 2:00 PM PT or Wednesday, October 28 at 10:00 AM PT? Let us know which works.

cases.desc: "Next week" with no date is no schedule
cases.subject: Call with Contoso
cases.body: We'd like to schedule a call with you next week to talk about the role.

cases.desc: A date with no time is no schedule
cases.subject: Interview with Northwind
cases.body: Your interview with Northwind is on October 27. Details to follow.

cases.desc: "Tomorrow at 3pm" has no date to anchor: not read
cases.subject: Interview with Contoso
cases.body: Interview with Contoso: tomorrow at 3pm if that works.

cases.desc: Tuesday, October 21, 2026 is a Wednesday: read, but below the default confidence
cases.subject: Interview with Margie's Travel
cases.body: Interview with Margie's Travel: Tuesday, October 21, 2026 at 2:00 PM PT.

cases.desc: 03/04/2026 may be March 4 or 3 April: below the default confidence
cases.subject: Interview with Alpine Ski House
cases.body: Interview with Alpine Ski House on 03/04/2026 10:00 AM ET.

cases.desc: A phone screen with a stated length
cases.subject: Interview with Contoso Ltd
cases.body: Interview with Contoso Ltd: our recruiter will call you on Wednesday, November 4 at 11:00 AM EST. The phone screen takes 30 minutes.
